name: Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 30, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a ghost out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "Clean means no witnesses, no evidence, no questions. That's three things. I charge for each."
"The target will stop breathing at the specified time. What you do with that information is your concern."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A corporate black site Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: As a ghost, Fanta Dahlberg-Boakye embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains)
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
